name: ListPluginStatus

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can specify up to 50 instances in a single request. Valid values of N: 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID，单次请求最多支持50台实例，N的取值范围为1~50
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The plugin name. The full character set is supported. The name can be up to 255 characters in length.

If you do not specify this parameter, the status of all installed plugins on the instance is queried.

    > If you do not specify this parameter, you can specify only one instance ID.

If you specify this parameter, the status of the specified plugin on the instances is queried
parameters.help_zh:
插件名称，支持全字符集。长度不得超过255个字符。

若不指定该参数，会查询实例中已安装插件的状态。

    > 若不指定该参数，只能指定一个实例ID。

若指定该参数，会查询出实例中指定插件的状态
parameters.name: name
